published_ranges._notes: Official GEEETECH store pages (PETG Black/White). GEEETECH staff replies on the White page: 'heat distortion temperature of PETG filament is 80C' (load/method not stated) and a single print temp of 235C; staff reply on Black page to a Bambu P1S user: nozzle 230C, bed 80-85C, 200 mm/s, no fan on first layer. No density published by GEEETECH.

conflicts: GEEETECH wiki (generic PETG section): nozzle 220-230C, bed 70-80C, fan 30-40%, retraction speed 25 mm/s - https://wiki.geeetech.com/index.php/Filament
Product page text also says PETG needs 'no heating bed', contradicting its own 80-90C bed spec.
Density 1.27 g/cm3 and 230-250C / bed 50-60C appear only on an unofficial mirror of a listing (museodiffuso.uniroma3.it); not used.
